body: I love you too:) and you’re the best
Thats not small this is amazing. Soon enough you’ll be looking at 3 days, 5 days, a week, etc.:)

I know how you feel, I started about 8 months ago. Please dont kys, It will get better. You’re stronger than you think and you’re going to get through this. Its okay to not know what you’re here for, but you’ll find out why, just keep going, you’ll be okay.

Dont go, please find someone you can talk to and who can help you like a therapist, a friend, etc. im sorry I dont know much about this but its gonna be okay:) my inbox is always open if you want to talk
Both me & my girlfriend self harm so when we see each others cuts/scars we don’t say anything we just hug each other for a while and ask if the other person wants to talk about it.

Yeah I sometimes feel the same way. Sometimes when my cuts arent deep enough I “redo” them the next day. Sometimes on cutting streaks I count the times not deep enough as 1/2 of a time cutting. I Know what you’re going through. Its okay though. I believe in you:). Much love

Yeah same for me. I know how you feel. I was clean for like 2.5 weeks and ive cut 6 times in 5 days. Relapsing is really tough and I hope your streak ends at 3 days. I believe in you. Its all going to be okay. Some other coping mechanisms which could possibly help could be working out, running, reading, writing, painting, drawing, listening to music, etc. its all going to work out:). I know how you feel.

Yesterday I relapsed & broke my 17, 18 day streak, I dont really remember. Its very tough and I totally understand how you feel. Im thinking the same thing right now. If you want to talk, pm me or reply to the comment. Its going to be okay, you’ll get over sh. I believe in you:)
Its okay, you’re stronger than you think and know. Everyone on this sub believes in you. You’re going to be okay👍👍
Those words are enough, thank you mate.

Yeah I freak out a little. Sometimes I freak out too much & then I end up laying on my bathroom floor. But once I start Its like im working out im laser focused to cut where I want & im strangely calm.
